notes: The interrogative εἰ is unrepresented, the ASV marking the question by inversion (rules 43, 44); a reference comparison will report it as a disagreement and that report is not a correction.

προσῆλθον keeps there came while the bare dative takes unto him under rule 106's oblique arm; ἀνθρώπῳ keeps for a man, the case preposition and supplied indefinite riding with the noun (rules 11, 21, 51).
